newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 30.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Firing drill in Pingtung, southern Taiwan, kills two, injures 18, as shell explodes during firing.
Taiwan dollar drops below T$28 against U.S. dollar.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Premier Lien Chan says Cabinet to be reshuffled on August 28, new one to be formed on August 30.
Two army soldiers killed, 18 injured when shell explodes during drill.

LIBERTY TIMES - Nationalist Party's 15th Congress to re-elect President Lee Teng-hui as party chairman; four vice chairmen will be former vice president Li Yuan-zu, Premier Lien Chan, former premier Yu Kuo-hwa, and senior presidential adviser Chiu Chuang-huan
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan dollar drops below T$28 against U.S. dollar
Trade unions call for institution of minimum salary law

ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Nationalist Party legislator Vincent Siew to be made head of cabinet; incumbent economics minister Wang Chih-kang to stay; Council for Economic Planning and Development chairman Chiang Pin-kung likely to become Taiwan's representative to Japan
Central bank lets go of T$28 defence of depreciating Taiwan dollar.
